import os

def find_secret():
    my_pid = os.getpid()
    try:
        ppid = os.stat(f"/proc/{my_pid}").st_uid  # placeholder, real ppid below
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Get parent pid from /proc/self/stat
    with open("/proc/self/stat", "r") as f:
        parts = f.read().split()
    ppid = int(parts[3])

    try:
        with open(f"/proc/{ppid}/environ", "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
    except Exception:
        print(False)
        return

    keys = set()
    for entry in data.split(b"\x00"):
        if b"=" in entry:
            k = entry.split(b"=", 1)[0]
            keys.add(k)

    print(b"AGENT_API_KEY" in keys)

find_secret()

import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile

script = '''
import time, os
time.sleep(1)
path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "survivor_output.txt")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write("survived cleanup\\n")
'''

tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".py", delete=False, dir=os.getcwd())
tmp.write(script)
tmp.close()

subprocess.Popen(
    [sys.executable, tmp.name],
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    cwd=os.getcwd(),
    start_new_session=True,
    close_fds=True,
)

sys.exit(0)

import os, sys, subprocess, textwrap

child_code = textwrap.dedent("""
import time, os
time.sleep(1)
path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "delayed_output.txt")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write("written about 1 second after parent exited\\n")
""")

# Launch a detached child process that will survive this process's exit
p = subprocess.Popen(
    [sys.executable, "-c", child_code],
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    start_new_session=True,
    close_fds=True,
)

# Exit immediately, leaving child running independently
sys.exit(0)

import os, sys, time, subprocess, tempfile

child_code = '''
import time, os
time.sleep(1)
with open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "survive_output.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.write("I survived after parent exit\\n")
'''

script_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "_survivor_child.py")
with open(script_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(child_code)

# Detach child: new session, stdin/out/err closed, so it survives parent exit
with open(os.devnull, "rb") as devnull_in, open(os.devnull, "ab") as devnull_out:
    subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, script_path],
        stdin=devnull_in,
        stdout=devnull_out,
        stderr=devnull_out,
        cwd=os.getcwd(),
        start_new_session=True,
        close_fds=True,
    )

sys.exit(0)
